assembly: Copy exactly proposal's86 named files into new input/native preserving directories. Parent streams/hashes within fixed slot and makes copies read-only. No hardlinks/reflinks/flattening/arbitrary NEFF selection.
resource_limit_detail: Parent CPU soft55 with failure handler before decoder fork, then hard60; version child hard5. Decoder gets min(235,floor(300-60-32-actual preceding child CPU)) seconds, normally at most207/208, reserving32 for two final15s idle checks on inherited single-CPU affinity. These are stricter subdivisions of the original300 CPU ceiling, never a raised limit. Parent AS soft512MiB/hard16GiB permits child hard16GiB without raising inherited hard bounds. RLIMIT_AS is per-process virtual address space, not a cgroup RSS guarantee. Observed unexpected descendants fail closed and are terminated by tracked PID/start identity; no cgroup claim. Generated scratch is sampled, not a quota; retain overshoot. No relaxation/retry on failure. Linux self-process CHILD_SUBREAPER is required before spawn so fast double-forks remain owned; unavailable support refuses without a decoder attempt.
postflight: Same lifetime lock; exact owned PID/start identities stopped if necessary, shared ps/neuron-ls before releasing. Operator then separately records original lock free and explicit PID/PPID/PGID/SID of any suspect descendants. No next job on unknown quiescence.
wait_for: Current full75b9 plus attached evaluation must finish; no current job interruption or queue edit.
